prompt:
Workflow step: Use the fixed robot arm to move the test tube from capping device to shaking device.
Inspection timing: after this step
Inspection location: shaking device
What the inspection checks: Check whether there is a capped test tube on shaking device.

A description of the inspection camera's photograph follows, written by someone who was not told what is being checked.

Description: A high-angle view of a lab bench area. Centre: a dark grey rack with multiple circular holes mounted on a white 3D-printed stand over an aluminium extrusion rail; the holes appear empty, with a teal/green tab on its right edge. A small printed marker (checkerboard/AprilTag pattern) sits on a plate behind it. Right of the rack: a white device with a black knob and small display, with white tubing and cables running down. Far right: a blue vacuum-pump-like machine, a black vertical post with clamps on a metal frame, a red-capped bottle, and a grey extrusion beam. Foreground bottom: white trays, one holding a stained dish and a white cylindrical container, plus black cables and dark rectangular blocks.
observations: The holes in the rack on the shaking device appear empty, indicating that the capped test tube was not successfully moved to the shaking device.
